ability.name: Flower Carpet
ability.note: While this Pokémon is not affected by a special condition and is on an entry point, Mega Evolution does not end via passage of turns for the Pokémon of the player whose entry point it is.

wheel.name: Synthesis
wheel.note: While they are on the field, your Grass-type Pokémon deal +20 damage to the battle opponent.

wheel.name: Seed Flare
wheel.note: If there are any poisoned and/or noxious Pokémon, this damage is multiplied by the number of those Pokémon. *Removes all poisoned and noxious conditions from all Pokémon.

wheel.name: Healing Flowers
wheel.note: Choose one Pokémon in your P.C. and move it to the bench.
